about: Engage-trash on a hop-capped ramp path. A pack at a ramp's foot sat inside the long-path corridor band, but DungeonClearEngageTrashAction approached it with stock MoveTo, a raw PathGenerator capped at about 74 hops. The walk down and around resolved PATHFIND_INCOMPLETE, the truncated prefix dead-ended, and the tank froze atop the ramp out of aggro range (memory dc-trash-engage-longpath-yield). The first fix (IsDirectlyReachable, 67dd0fd5) yields to Advance's uncapped long path. S1513 (96ca4211) bounded that yield and latched it per target, so a pack beside the route is not abandoned mid-tag. Staged from a real Utgarde Keep pull taken 10yd above the pack on the way to Ingvar (tr-20260922-185328-8#36, the same layout in -29#32, -38#37, -44#33). Bonecrusher, Spiritualist and the two Savage Worgs that always join are the target. PullSetting 0 routes it through the engage-trash rung rather than the pull FSM. UNVERIFIED geometry: the original hop-cap report did not name its ramp.
